ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: In Incoming::poll_frame's H2 branch, reading trailers must treat h2 RST_STREAM with NO_ERROR as a graceful end (Poll::Ready(None)) instead of surfacing it as a body error. The data-frame branch is also re-shaped so only NO_ERROR maps to Ready(None); CANCEL now propagates as an error.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: PR title 'fix(client): reading trailers shouldn't propagate NO_ERROR from early response' and body explicitly extend the #3275 body-read fix to trailers, citing RFC 7540 §8.1 RST_STREAM(NO_ERROR) early-response semantics. A trailers-only variant of http2_responds_before_consuming_request_body is added that fails without the patch, anchoring the trailer error-propagation change as the central fix.
